written.myAnswer: Within the elastic limit, extension or compression is directly proportional to the applied force (F = kx). Beyond the elastic limit, an object may be permanently deformed and will not return to its original shape when the force is removed.
Series: total extension = 2x and equivalent spring constant = k/2. Parallel: total extension = x/2 and equivalent spring constant = 2k.
Steel is more elastic than iron: it has a greater ability to return to its original shape after the deforming force is removed, provided its elastic limit is not exceeded.

Within the elastic limit, extension or compression is directly proportional to the applied force (F = kx). Applications include spring balances, the balance wheel of a mechanical clock, and galvanometers.
The spring constant is 2 kN m⁻¹. The weight causing an extension of 16 mm is 32 N.
